description: Non-combatant escort at The Lord of the Rings: be part of Middle-earth without fighting. What we expect from you, costume, registration and how to take part.
title: Non-combatant escort
subtitle: Part of Middle-earth without fighting.
who_p1_pre: Non-combatant escort is for participants who want to come to the event, be in camp, soak in the atmosphere, support their army or friends, but
who_p1_strong: do not want to take part in the fighting
who_l2: bards, craftspeople, chroniclers and camp characters,
who_l4: players who want to enjoy the story, the camp and the community without direct combat.
who_note: A non-combatant escort is still part of the event. Just with a different way of taking part.
h_60s: The most important things in 60 seconds
s60_l1_post: and does not enter combat encounters.
s60_l2: The event rules, organiser instructions and safety principles still apply.
s60_l3: In camp, you behave as part of the world of Middle-earth.
s60_l4: Ideally have a simple costume, or at least civilian clothing that doesn’t break the atmosphere.
s60_l5: If you want to be in the encampment of a particular army, arrange it with their group or the organisers.
s60_l6: During the main game on Saturday, only move in places where you won’t obstruct combat, organisation or safety.
h_what: What you can do at the event
what_intro: Non-combatant escort helps create the atmosphere of the campsite and the whole event. You can take part for example like this:
what_l1: be part of an army camp,
what_l2: help with the logistics of your group,
what_l4: take part in the Friday side programme,
what_l5: join in camp life, coins, small games and micro-quests,
what_l6: help with children or family logistics (if pre-arranged),
what_l7: help with preparing equipment, decorations, fire, water or small camp tasks.
exp_l1: Respect for players, organisers and medics.
exp_l2: Consideration for the combat side of the event.
exp_l3: A clear distinction that you are not a fighting participant.
exp_l4: Following camp rules, fire safety, quiet hours and safety in general.
exp_l5: If you’re not sure where you’re allowed to be, ask the organisers.
exp_l6: If you want to enter the game space during Saturday’s play, it must be safe and pre-arranged.
cos_intro: Non-combatant escort doesn’t need full combat gear. Still, the more you blend into the atmosphere, the better. We recommend:
cos_l1: a simple tunic, cloak, shirt, scarf or wool layers,
cos_l2: natural colours: brown, green, grey, beige, black,
cos_l4: avoiding reflective colours, sports logos and obviously modern clothing,
cos_note: If you’re coming with a particular army, stick to its colours and style.
reg_p1: Non-combatant escorts register the same way as other participants.
reg_p2: After completing registration you’ll receive payment information. You can pay via QR code or bank transfer. The registration fee must be paid within 10 days of registering.
reg_alert_pre: If you’re not sure which role to choose during registration, write to us beforehand at
link2_post: — date, place, arrival, accommodation and gear.
link3_post: — they apply to non-combatant escort too.
link4_post: — pick the side you want to belong to thematically.
cta_heading: Want to come as non-combatant escort?
cta_body: Excellent. Middle-earth isn’t only about the battle. The camp, the story, friends and the atmosphere also need people who don’t fight, but build the world around it.
